label: The spec's §7 quartet under renamed names, plus the VAE soup
description: THE HASH-CATALOG AC PROFILE (to7xpa7 task CT7, spec docs/specs/2026-10-17-hash-catalog.md §7): the maintainer-instance profile's shape carrying the walkthrough's quartet of diffusion checkpoints under RENAMED, needle-free basenames (renamed/aurora_master = official FL2VA, renamed/borealis_master = official Ref2VA, renamed/cascade_motion = the Viggle-Animate build, renamed/dualstream_merge = the smhfacct hybrid — no family token in any basename, the name-invisible case only sha256 can resolve), with the full supporting stack (TE, VAEs, turbo) under canonical names, and the VAE SOUP: byte-identical alias copies of the video VAE fp16 (the ~30-variant setCMBalias2 walkthrough shape, sampled at two), a distinct-sha q8 variant, and minimax_h3_t1_image_vae_fp16 — a T=1-NAMED file whose BYTES are the video VAE's (the name's lie the digest corrects). The synthetic files these names stand for are written by tests/lib/hashfixture.cjs quartetSoupWorld — the e2e boot points MONOKA_HASH_CATALOG at that world's fixture catalog and settings.modelRoot at its root, so the studio reads the very bytes the catalog describes. Provenance: the spec §1 walkthrough (four confusable checkpoints, 45 VAE files / ~30 near-duplicates) and §7's quartet definition; the fixture discipline keeps every sha real (computed from the synthetic bytes at fixture-build time, never invented).
